# Provider Compatibility Table

Generated from the harness adapters in `agent_extensions/sync/harness.py`. Change the adapter or the generator, then run `python3 -m agent_extensions.sync.matrix --write`.

## Capability coverage

Each cell is what the adapter's `capability_report` accepts for that kind: `supported` or `unsupported`. The `mcp` probe uses stdio transport; a harness that accepts only some transports names the rest in its gaps.

| Harness | skill | plugin | agent | command | hook | mcp | connector |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| antigravity | supported | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | supported | unsupported |
| claude-code | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| cline | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| codex | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | supported | unsupported |
| generic | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | supported | unsupported |
| kilo | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| local | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | supported | unsupported |
| opencode | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| pi | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |

Every adapter's `translate()` keeps every canonical entry. Adapters never add, drop, or rename a capability; the only per-harness differences are the transport key, the declared gaps, the import instruction, and the detection markers.

## Harness detail

The stub harnesses (cline, kilo, opencode, pi) claim skills only. They have no environment marker, are not in the legacy `adapters.PROVIDERS` tuple, and are selected with `AE_HARNESS=<name>`. Every other kind is a named gap.

### antigravity

- Legacy provider key: `antigravity`
- Detection: `AE_HARNESS` override only
- MCP transport key: `serverUrl`
- Import: `link plugins/<plugin> under $ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGINS_DIR`
- Gaps: `hook-inheritance`, `sandbox`
- Gap reason: the hook wrapper bridges invocation only, not Claude-native hook semantics; sandbox behaviour is not modelled

### claude-code

- Legacy provider key: `claude`
- Detection: env `CLAUDECODE=1`, `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT` set; or `AE_HARNESS=claude-code`
- MCP transport key: `url`
- Import: `marketplace add agent-extensions; install <plugin>`
- Gaps: none
- Gap reason: none

### cline

- Legacy provider key: none (not a legacy provider)
- Detection: `AE_HARNESS` override only
- MCP transport key: none
- Import: `read plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md directly (stub: no installer support)`
- Gaps: `hooks`, `plugins`, `agents`, `commands`, `connectors`, `mcp`, `subagent-model-tiers`
- Gap reason: no Cline code in this repo; the SKILL.md read path is unverified and every other surface is undeclared

## Hook bridging

Non-Claude providers route hooks via `bootstrap/hook_env_wrapper.py` (which sets `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and translates the JSON payload). Hook inheritance is declared unsupported on codex/antigravity — the wrapper bridges invocation, it does not inherit Claude-native hook semantics. Bulk porting of agent/hook/command definitions is Stage 22; live conformance canaries are Stage 23; cloud/mobile/web bundles are Stage 24.

## Regenerating

Regenerate after any adapter change: `python3 -m agent_extensions.sync.matrix --write`. `python3 -m agent_extensions.sync.matrix` prints the same text without writing. The drift test in `tests/test_harness_matrix.py` fails when this file is hand-edited.
